answer: I possess no reverse side, nor do I record inscriptions found upon photographs; I am strictly the Guest List penned by Eleanor Whitcombe. While my records confirm the presence of Miss M. Vega at Seat 7 from 1928 to 1931, I have no knowledge of the name Marisol or any annotations you describe.
